calls.text:
{
"meetingId":"174",
"tickets":[
{
"templateId":"9e7b07e0-527c-53c6-8dd4-4cf4800a75ae",
"title":"Coordinate Divorce Planning Documents",
"text":"Client household: Lena Copperwisp\nPrimary contact: Lena Copperwisp\nAttorney or mediator contact: Hana Lanternmoss, Paper Otter Family Law\nCPA or tax professional contact: Owen Dewspindle, Clockwork Clover Tax\nCurrent matter status: Settlement Review\nDocuments requested: Velvet Acorn Custody accounts, Amber Teapot Retirement Services plan, Teacup Comet Bank balances, residence debt, insurance benefits, education savings accounts\nPermission to coordinate with professionals on file: YES\nSecure upload location or delivery method: Portal\nKnown timing constraints or court-related milestones: Inventory due November 4, 2025\nOpen questions for advisor review: None\nPrepare the consolidated inventory for attorney Hana Lanternmoss by November 4, 2025, including account balances and debt details as outlined.",
"priority":"medium",
"dueDate":"2025-11-04",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to prepare that inventory by November 4, 2025."
},
{
"templateId":null,
"title":"Obtain Missing Settlement Documents",
"text":"Obtain the valuation report for Copper Firefly Builders, the latest home equity line statement, and the most recent Pocket Lantern Education Savings ownership confirmations for Lena Copperwisp, and deliver them to attorney Hana Lanternmoss by November 7, 2025.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2025-11-07",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to obtain those records by November 7, 2025."
},
{
"templateId":null,
"title":"Address Marital Balance Sheet Discrepancy",
"text":"Address the discrepancy between the draft marital balance sheet’s listed value for Lena’s Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account and the actual dashboard value, investigating pending tax withholding or unsettled trades, for Lena Copperwisp by November 5, 2025.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2025-11-05",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to address that discrepancy by November 5, 2025."
},
{
"templateId":null,
"title":"Compare Home Buyout and Rental Options",
"text":"Compare keeping the marital residence, selling the home, and renting through Noah’s graduation to assess buyout and debt structure viability for Lena Copperwisp, and provide analysis by November 12, 2025.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2025-11-12",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to compare keeping the home, selling the home, and renting through Noah’s graduation by November 12, 2025."
},
{
"templateId":null,
"title":"Complete Attorney and CPA Authorization",
"text":"Complete the authorization for Apricot Compass Advisory to coordinate directly with attorney Hana Lanternmoss and CPA Owen Dewspindle regarding settlement cash flow and tax assumptions for Lena Copperwisp by October 31, 2025.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2025-10-31",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to complete the authorization step by October 31, 2025."
},
{
"templateId":null,
"title":"Prepare Current-Year Tax Projection",
"text":"Prepare a current-year tax projection incorporating Lena’s realized gains, temporary support payments, expected bonus income, and potential stock sales for coordination with Clockwork Clover Tax before settlement numbers are finalized, due November 10, 2025.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2025-11-10",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection by November 10, 2025."
},
{
"templateId":"c973af7d-fbf6-5b5b-8069-93c17b6bf193",
"title":"Review Beneficiary Update Evidence",
"text":"Review criteria:\n- Confirm every relevant account, policy, retirement plan, annuity, trust-owned account, and transfer-on-death registration has been considered.\n- Compare requested beneficiaries against the client’s estate planning summary, known family structure, and prior instructions.\n- Verify primary and contingent beneficiaries, percentages, per stirpes or per capita language if available, and any trust or charity naming requirements.\n- Confirm spousal consent, plan administrator approval, or custodian-specific forms if required.\nEvidence to collect:\n- Current beneficiary confirmation from the custodian, insurer, employer plan, or administrator.\n- Signed beneficiary change forms or electronic confirmation receipts.\n- Trust name, date, trustee role, and tax identification handling if a trust is named.\n- Notes confirming the client reviewed the designations and understands account-specific limitations.\nDo not mark complete until confirmation evidence is saved to the client record.\nReview Lena Copperwisp’s retirement account, life insurance, and transfer‑on‑death designations to ensure Gareth Copperwisp is removed where appropriate, and complete the review by November 14, 2025.",
"priority":"high",
"dueDate":"2025-11-14",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to review those designations and documents by November 14, 2025."
},
{
"templateId":"ac1be443-12a5-53dc-ae3d-0495f62337d5",
"title":"Review Concentrated Position Exposure",
"text":"Complete the following checks:\n- Identify position, account location, cost basis, unrealized gain or loss, holding period, and restrictions.\n- Calculate position size as a percentage of portfolio, investable assets, and net worth where available.\n- Review liquidity needs, tax bracket, charitable intent, estate considerations, and risk tolerance.\n- Check for employer-related constraints such as trading windows, blackout periods, Rule 144, 10b5-1 plans, or insider status if relevant.\n- Compare diversification alternatives, including staged sales, exchange funds, option strategies, gifting, charitable vehicles, and tax-loss harvesting offsets.\n- Document recommended action, implementation sequence, tax assumptions, and approvals needed before trading.\nDevelop a staged diversification plan for Lena Copperwisp’s Silver Marmot Design Group stock, considering tax impact, settlement liquidity, and blackout‑period constraints, and deliver the plan by November 18, 2025.",
"priority":"high",
"dueDate":"2025-11-18",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to provide that plan by November 18, 2025."
},
{
"templateId":"c7e43e6e-7f72-56f6-9f51-92cf01ed3788",
"title":"Restore Client Portal Access",
"text":"Use this workflow when a client reports a locked login, lost multi-factor device, expired invitation, or other access issue. Confirm identity through approved procedures before discussing account details, document each contact attempt, and close the loop only after the client confirms successful access or the issue is escalated to the custodian or platform support team.\nResolve Lena Copperwisp’s Velvet Acorn Custody portal login issue caused by multi‑factor code failure after phone replacement, and confirm access restoration by October 30, 2025.",
"priority":"medium",
"dueDate":"2025-10-30",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[
{
"title":"Verify identity and issue scope",
"text":"Confirm the requester through approved verification steps. Record the affected platform, username or email on file, error message, device type, and whether account data was exposed or changed.",
"priority":"medium",
"dueDate":null,
"assigneeId":"968d1e89-a266-526b-b1e6-cdc943d4056b"
},
{
"title":"Coordinate reset or escalation",
"text":"Initiate the approved password reset, invitation reissue, multi-factor reset, or custodian service request. Avoid sending sensitive credentials by email or text.",
"priority":"medium",
"dueDate":null,
"assigneeId":"968d1e89-a266-526b-b1e6-cdc943d4056b"
},
{
"title":"Review security implications",
"text":"If the access problem involved a suspicious login, changed contact information, or an unknown device, review for possible account security escalation and document the recommended next steps.",
"priority":"high",
"dueDate":null,
"assigneeId":"de6801b9-5232-55e8-a20f-6b40f26c2343"
},
{
"title":"Confirm restoration with client",
"text":"Ask the client to confirm they can log in, view the expected account, and use required authentication. Record confirmation and any remaining support needs.",
"priority":"medium",
"dueDate":null,
"assigneeId":"7526fb2c-eb3f-5fd9-bdab-72ee8fc12ff1"
}
],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to resolve the portal access issue by October 30, 2025."
},
{
"templateId":"9ac01abf-b748-5444-916f-fecbf96cee7b",
"title":"Coordinate Account Security Follow-Up",
"text":"Use this coordination template when there is a potential account security concern. Keep communications factual, use secure channels, avoid including sensitive account details in open messages, and document each handoff and resolution step.\nReview Lena Copperwisp’s account security and update contact information, including removal of the shared household email from recovery contacts, and complete the review by October 31, 2025.",
"priority":"high",
"dueDate":"2025-10-31",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[
{
"title":"Log incident and preserve details",
"text":"Record how the concern was identified, affected accounts or platforms, client-reported facts, suspicious messages or phone numbers, and any immediate restrictions already placed.",
"priority":"high",
"dueDate":null,
"assigneeId":"de6801b9-5232-55e8-a20f-6b40f26c2343"
},
{
"title":"Contact custodian or platform security team",
"text":"Coordinate with the custodian or platform using approved service channels. Request status of account restrictions, recent profile changes, pending transactions, and recommended protective steps.",
"priority":"high",
"dueDate":null,
"assigneeId":"968d1e89-a266-526b-b1e6-cdc943d4056b"
},
{
"title":"Advisor client follow-up",
"text":"Speak with the client through a verified contact method. Confirm recent activity, explain next steps, and remind the client to update credentials and review devices where appropriate.",
"priority":"high",
"dueDate":null,
"assigneeId":"7526fb2c-eb3f-5fd9-bdab-72ee8fc12ff1"
},
{
"title":"Portfolio and transaction review",
"text":"Review recent trading, money movement, standing instructions, and pending requests for irregular activity. Escalate any unexplained activity before normal processing resumes.",
"priority":"high",
"dueDate":null,
"assigneeId":"ac82dfcd-bd79-558c-8740-1d41b44e5f2f"
}
],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to review the account security and contact information by October 31, 2025."
},
{
"templateId":null,
"title":"Prepare Education Savings Ownership Notes",
"text":"Prepare planning notes on successor ownership, control of future contributions, and settlement language for the Pocket Lantern Education Savings accounts currently owned by Gareth Copperwisp, for Lena Copperwisp, and deliver the notes by November 20, 2025.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2025-11-20",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to prepare those planning notes by November 20, 2025."
},
{
"templateId":null,
"title":"Prepare Revised Retirement Projection",
"text":"Prepare a revised retirement income projection for Lena Copperwisp using single‑household expenses, potential residence outcomes, expected support changes, retirement account division assumptions, Social Security timing, and a reduced employer‑stock exposure target, and deliver the projection by December 5, 2025.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2025-12-05",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to prepare the revised projection by December 5, 2025."
}
]
